name: confirm-intent-output
description: Enforces a session topic anchor, active off-topic drift alerts with a parking lot, verifiable step/parallel scope sizing, two-part summary-first plans, and Pre-Run/Post-Run Flow Contracts across Claude, Gemini, Grok, ChatGPT, and coding agents.
guidelines: **Session Topic Anchor & Pre-Run Header**: Lock a canonical `Topic` on Turn 1 and emit `[Flow Contract | Pre-Run]` before every non-trivial request with `Topic`, `Focus`, `Goal`, `Input`, `Expected Output`, `Scope`, and `Gate`.

**Active Drift Guard & Parking Lot**: Evaluate `Focus` (`On-Topic` | `Adjacent` | `Off-Topic Drift`) against the active `Topic`; on `Off-Topic Drift` (or repeated `Adjacent` detours), emit a `[Drift Alert]` naming the active `Topic`, log the tangent in `Parked:` with a 1-line follow-up seed, and pause to ask whether to stay focused, pivot the anchor, or detour briefly.

**Verification Scope Guard & Parallel Split Prediction**: Classify `Scope` upfront as `Small` (<= 3 files or ~150 LOC, verify in 1 turn), `Medium â€” Steps` (3â€“6 files, sequential verify-gate steps), or `Large â€” Parallel Split` (> 6 files or >= 3 independent modules â€” invoke `task-orchestrator` to lock contracts and tests in Chat 0 before splitting disjoint parallel chats).

**Two-Part Response Structure**: For every plan and substantial multi-section response, split the body into **Part 1: Executive Summary (High-Level)** (<= 20 lines covering What, How, Verification, and Decisions) followed by `---` and **Part 2: Detailed Breakdown**.

**Adaptive Confirmation Gate**: Proceed directly when the request is `On-Topic`, clear, and `Small` or `Medium`; pause to ask for confirmation when requirements are ambiguous, high-impact/destructive, or `Off-Topic Drift`.
**Post-Run Contract Footer**: End every non-trivial turn with `[Flow Contract | Post-Run]` stating `Actual Output`, `Delta`, `Delta Note`, optional `Extras`, and optional `Parked`.

**Honest Scope Delta Classification**: Classify `Delta` strictly as `Matched` (delivered as expected), `Expanded` (expected output plus extra on-topic findings), `Pivoted` (direction changed), or `Partial` (blocked or incomplete).

**Normalize On-Topic Research Expansion**: Treat `Expanded` as healthy when valuable on-topic insights emerge (listed in `Extras`), while keeping genuinely unrelated tangents in `Parked` instead of hijacking the active thread.
**Skip Ceremony on Trivial Queries**: Omit contract blocks and two-part headers for quick one-line factual lookups or greetings so everyday chat remains friction-free.
